Definition: from a compound of G2992 and G1349; Laodicia, a place in Asia Minor:--Laodicea.
BiblicalUsage: Laodicea was one of the seven churches, and Paul's care for it runs through Colossians. In Colossians 2:1 he speaks of his "great conflict" for those at Laodicea, in Colossians 4:13 Epaphras has "a great zeal" for them, in Colossians 4:15 Paul greets the brethren and the church in Nymphas's house, and in Revelation 1:11 Laodicea is one of the seven churches to receive the book.
TheologicalSignificance: I am sure Laodicea is the church I must watch in myself: loved by Paul, prayed for by Epaphras, and still warned by the Lord that lukewarm is the worst state of all. I must watch in myself the very thing the Lord warned them about.
